The House just passed another bipartisan War Powers Resolution to put this reckless president in check.

Our servicemembers should never be put in harm’s way because Trump decided to ignore the Constitution.

Do your job. End this war. NOW.

posts.text:
John Lewis gave everything to protect our right to vote. His courage, sacrifice, and commitment to justice were unmatched.

Now, six years after his passing, this Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act — the very protections he marched, bled, and fought to defend.

John Lewis didn't quit — and neither will we.

Let's honor his legacy by passing the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and channel that same Good Trouble energy.

If that were the case, this administration wouldn't be firing members of the bipartisan Election Assistance Commission — the very people who help states run secure and fair elections.

It is an attempt to suppress votes. And with the midterms around the corner…the timing speaks for itself.

posts.text:
Happy 250th, America.

As we celebrate, let's honor those who built this country, defended it, and never stopped pushing America to live up to its promise.

The fight for freedom isn't over. And the next 250 years will depend on what we do now.

We've got work to do.
